explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 72 named tracks across roughly seventeen releases, label pages and editorial roundups: current August–September electronic releases, emerging hardware-rhythm work, adjacent free-form electronic material and overlooked TRULE catalogue. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Completed Runs 211, 213, 214, 217 and 218 source fields and selected identities were excluded; failed Run 212 identities were not reused.

Every exact artist/title pair below was checked against the canonical ledger, target discoveries, local discovery pool, active rejections, PARKED revisit queue and global utility ledger before ranking; none was present.
The repetition check compared the previous five completed discovery runs (211, 213, 214, 217 and 218). None of the nine placements repeats a selected-candidate boundary from those runs.

Nine honest leads survived without padding. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both protected handoffs remain untouched. No Spotify connector, raw audio, invented identity or metadata-to-feeling inference was used.
